items.title: UPS Partners With TikTok Shop for No-Box, No-Label Returns Service
items.summary: UPS (NYSE:UPS) has entered into a partnership with TikTok Shop to provide an exclusive no-box, no-label returns service for participating sellers on the social commerce platform in the United States. The service will be provided through Happy Returns, allowing TikTok Shop customers to return eligible products without packaging or printed shipping labels.
